title: Amsterdamse co-assistenten 1971
authors: Eijk, C. van der, Stokman, F.N., Universiteit van Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Instituut voor wetenschap der politiek, IWP (primary investigator)
contributors: Students of sociale academie * Amsterdam (data collector)
descriptions: Attitude to organization of courses for students in medicine / actual and desired number of candidates for each course / task description compared to what the General Practitioner himself should do / relationship to patients / task preferences / evaluation procedures / sources of information on the G.P.'s task / career perspective / attitude towards the relation G.P.- patient / attitude to birth control, sterilization, abortion, euthanasia. Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ occupation/employment/ education/ religion
